newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE at record but dealing sluggish.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE at record but dealing sluggish.

text.p: The UK stock market set new highs on Tuesday on the back of Wall Street's second consecutive closing record but opening trade saw prices come off their peaks as investors questioned the market's energy, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 index reached a record 3,986.7 points in early dealings but slipped to 3,981.1, up 3.9 points, by 0758 GMT.
Traders said the market, despite a string of as-expected corporate results, had reached a psychological crossroads as investors speculated what lay beyond the key 4,000 point level.
"The problem is, we've reached the edge of the map and people are sitting down to think, what next?", one dealer said.
